jobs.title: Backend / Embedded Systems Developer
jobs.summary: This role connects low-level embedded devices with cloud and enterprise backend architectures to deliver reliable firmware and server side services. The successful candidate will design and maintain APIs and embedded software to ensure data integrity performance and device reliability.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu About Us LMB Soft d.o.o. Niš is a research and development company with over 40 years of experience and a trusted leader in the medical technology field. We specialize in the development and production of blood transfusion devices and are proud to be part of the MacoPharma Group, a global leader in the manufacturing of blood bags and in-line systems. Through close integration with international teams and systems, our employees gain valuable professional experience and continuous development in a dynamic, multidisciplinary, and highly regulated environment. Position Overview – Backend / Embedded Systems Developer LMB Soft is looking for a versatile and motivated Backend & Embedded Systems Developer with expertise in C#, JavaScript/Node.js, and C / Embedded OS to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between low-level device/hardware systems and high-level cloud or enterprise backend architectures. You will design and maintain reliable server-side services, RESTful APIs, and firmware/embedded software for edge devices. Key Responsibilities Designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance backend services and APIs using C# (.NET / .NET Core) and JavaScript (Node.js); Writing, testing, and maintaining efficient C/C++ code for embedded systems and real-time operating systems (RTOS) or Embedded Linux; Connecting embedded/IoT devices with backend cloud architectures, MQTT/WebSockets messaging pipelines, and database systems; Designing and optimizing relational (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL Server) and non-relational (e.g. MongoDB) databases for scalable data ingestion; Writing clean, maintainable code and conducting hardware/software debugging, unit testing, and integration testing across environments; Optimizing low-level device performance, memory footprint, power consumption, and backend query response times; Collaborating closely with hardware engineers, frontend developers, DevOps, and product managers to deliver end-to-end solutions. jobs.title: Principal Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.summary: The Principal Full-Stack Engineer will convert high-level direction into production software, owning prototypes through to hardened services with a backend-first focus. The role centers on running agent-driven development at scale, ensuring deployments, monitoring, and cost control while delivering new AI-enabled platform capabilities to real users.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu PRINCIPAL FULL-STACK ENGINEER REMOTE/FULL-TIME Reports to: CTO About the role We're hiring a Principal Full-Stack Engineer to work directly with our CTO on new strategic initiatives at Digistore24. You'll take an idea from a rough direction to working software in production, mostly on your own. This is a hands-on role: you'll write a lot of code, and you'll orchestrate a lot of agents to write more of it. Who is Digistore24? Digistore24 is the all-in-one online sales platform that combines the world's largest international affiliate marketplace with industry-leading conversion tools. Founded in Germany in 2012, we've been the online market leader in Germany since 2014 and have been expanding rapidly in the US since 2020. Today, more than 5 million users and 125,000+ active affiliates work with us, and over $5.1 billion in sales has gone through the platform. We're self-funded and work fully remote, with team members across Europe and the US. Eklektika, a company from Belgrade, has existed for 20 years and recently became an integral part of the German/USA company Digistore24. What you'll be working on Digistore24 is one of the world's leading online sales platforms, with the largest international affiliate marketplace in the industry. Vendors use us to sell, affiliates use us to find offers to promote, and more than 5 million users work with us. You'll work on what comes next: new products and new capabilities on the platform, with a strong focus on AI and how agents will change commerce. Most of the work is new. You'll build new services and products rather than maintain old ones, though you'll sometimes dig through our existing PHP codebase to work out how things behave today and what a new version needs to do. The scope will change, and a lot of it will start as a prototype. You'll start with a few specific workflows. Within roughly your first four months, the goal is to have something real shipped and in the hands of pilot customers. What you'll do Turn direction into working software. Take a goal from the CTO, break it down, plan your own work, decide how to build it, and ship it. Escalate only when something really needs it. Build end-to-end, backend first. Services, APIs, data pipelines, and integrations, plus the frontend on top. Whatever the problem needs. Mine the old to build the new. Read the existing codebase to pull out the real requirements, edge cases, and business rules a new version has to respect. Prototype, then harden. Get something working fast, learn from it, and turn what works into production-quality software. Run what you build. Deployment, monitoring, and cost control are part of the job. Reference: Xqksm6lDRWp85bkhESQO42kp4NsDqvJ6PGyR77Ks-v0Mo1jql8zbb9RXa1xZQAFh How we build We build with coding agents every day, and this role sits at the far end of that. We're looking for someone who already works in fully agentic workflows rather than someone who uses an AI assistant now and then. That means: You run agents autonomously on real work: several in parallel, on long-running tasks, with as little hand-holding as possible. You give agents what they need to succeed: clear specs, context, conventions, and tests. You structure codebases so agents can work in them reliably. You verify what agents produce, catch what's subtly wrong, and build the guardrails that keep quality high. You know where agents can be trusted and where a human has to stay in the loop, especially around money. You're tool-agnostic.

jobs.title: Senior BI & Data Specialist
jobs.summary: This role owns the group data and analytics platform to deliver certified semantic models and a single source of truth. The specialist will maintain production operations, implement governance and provide standardized Power BI solutions and automated management reporting.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu Join our team Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Regent Lighting employs around 600 people in six countries, is the market leader in Switzerland and one of the leading lighting manufacturers in Europe. Through distribution partners, our products are distributed internationally in 35 countries. For our location in Svilajnac we are looking for a: SENIOR BI & DATA SPECIALIST YOUR TASKS Operate and develop our Group-wide Data & Analytics platform on Microsoft Fabric - Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks; Build and maintain the medallion architecture with standardized data ingestion from Dynamics 365 F&SCM, and provide certified, reusable semantic models as the single source of truth; Develop and operate Group-wide Power BI solutions and standardized KPI dashboards for Finance, Controlling, Sales, Supply Chain and Operations, and automate month-end close, forecast and budget reporting; Keep the platform running: monitor refreshes, jobs and pipelines, resolve errors and incidents, manage workspaces, permissions and row-level security, and watch Fabric capacity usage and cost; Work to ALM best practice across DEV – TEST – PROD with Fabric deployment pipelines and Git integration in Azure DevOps; Implement data governance standards (data security, sensitivity labels, RBAC, data lineage, cataloguing) and safeguard data quality across all legal entities; Take over solutions currently run by external partners, including structured knowledge transfer, and steer those partners: specify, review, accept deliverables; Enable key users to build their own reports on certified models, and translate business requirements from the business functions into functional and technical specifications. Reference: LHjTSWUuthmal3p8X55G1HEJRBn0qJiRo6snD-CvB6UPqqODNwOYD1lJrbhk4ZrY YOUR PROFILE At least 5 years in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering or Reporting Solutions, including several years hands-on with Microsoft Fabric or the Azure data stack (Synapse, Data Factory); Power BI at expert level: DAX, Power Query, semantic modelling; Strong SQL, data warehousing and data modelling (star schema, medallion architecture); ALM / CI-CD for BI solutions: deployment pipelines, Git, Azure DevOps; Experience with ERP data, ideally Dynamics 365 F&SCM; KPI and management reporting; A degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Data Analytics or a comparable field — or equivalent professional experience; Fluent English; German is an advantage; Structured, self-driven working style, ownership for production operations, and the ability to explain technical topics so that business colleagues follow. NICE TO HAVE Dynamics 365 F&SCM or AX data model, data entities, integration via Link to Microsoft Fabric / Synapse Link; Azure Data Services (Data Factory, Synapse); Python / PySpark; Data governance with Microsoft Purview; Certifications PL-300, DP-600 or DP-700. WHAT WE OFFER An innovative company with a dynamic environment and requirements; Collaboration with our experienced team in Switzerland; An environment with a fail fast mentality with an open mind for new technologies and methodologies; The possibility to work on new and exciting projects in an ever-changing business landscape; Flexible working hours.
